changelog: Meter UI edit now has POSITION + SIZE controls on top (size uses crisp zoom rendering — no blurry scaling — in 5% steps, saved per player; Config.UI.Size/MinSize/MaxSize). Job & duty now actually gate the meter: UI open, U-key, /taxiuiedit, meter start and billing all require the taxi job and clock-in. Config.AllAllowVehicle now only widens the vehicle whitelist — it no longer bypasses job/duty checks.
